cut_spare_application_reference.purpose: CUT-owned integration intent and external reference; never a spare application lifecycle
checks: external_application_no and launch_url are trimmed when non-null
deleted is always false for business history
rows are append-only and never soft-deleted

cut_spare_manual_evidence.purpose: immutable PLT file fact reference for manual fallback evidence
checks: all file versions are non-negative and file_version_no>0
rows are append-only and never soft-deleted

jsonContracts.status_snapshot: validated JSON object maximum 16 KiB; no credentials, secrets, file bytes or instruction execution

sourceAndVersionRules.request: platform_request_id allocated once before first provider call and reused for the same intent
sourceAndVersionRules.status: positive monotonic status_version per external application; lower is audit-only, equal same payload replay, equal different payload conflict, higher append
sourceAndVersionRules.currentPointer: application current_status_revision_id and status current_marker update atomically after append

migration.strategy: NEW_ONLY through the actual next available Flyway version
migration.seed: add only pms:cutover-task:manage-spare under the existing cutover workbench; no role grant and no provider configuration

dependencies.INT-06: SpareApplicationGateway production Provider; blocks production activation and Implementation Done, not CUT controlled implementation
dependencies.PROJ/AST: existing project/device lock revalidation paths from F-CUT-002
dependencies.PLT: existing FileArtifactApi immutable file fact validation
dependencies.F-CUT-005: read-only FULL approval projection extension only

controlledPositiveLoop: CUT tests may assemble deterministic INT-06, PROJ/AST and PLT substitutes to prove initiate -> external reference -> status callback/refresh -> P5 display; substitutes never enter src/main production assembly
